faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most common questions

items.question: Is Mutqin recognized by SCFHS?
items.answer: Yes, Mutqin is aligned with Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) standards. All accredited events on the platform comply with required standards, and registered hours are officially accredited.

items.question: How do I track my CME hours?
items.answer: You can easily track your Continuing Medical Education (CME) hours through your dashboard. Tracking is automatic when you attend events and check in via QR. You can also export reports for sync with Mumaris Plus platform.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes, your data is completely safe. We use full encryption for all data, and all servers are hosted in Saudi Arabia to ensure full compliance with local regulations.

items.question: Can I cancel my account?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your account at any time from account settings. All your data will be securely deleted according to privacy policy.

items.question: How do I get my certificate?
items.answer: You get your certificate automatically after checking in to the event via QR. The certificate will be ready for download immediately from your dashboard.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: We accept all local and international payment methods: Mada, Visa, Mastercard, and Apple Pay. All transactions are secure and encrypted.

whatIs.title: Mutqin is the operating system for accredited CPD activities
whatIs.body: Mutqin connects providers, accreditors, regulators, hospitals, sponsors, and HCPs in one workflow from activity design to recorded credits.

howItWorks.title: How Mutqin runs each activity from idea to credits
howItWorks.subtitle: From accreditation to attendance to posted hours, Mutqin keeps every step connected, documented, and auditable.

create.title: Activity created
create.description: CPD provider creates the activity using a unified template with objectives, faculty, agenda, and disclosures in one structured package.

accredit.title: Accreditation submitted
accredit.description: Single accreditation package containing all required information is submitted to the regulator through Mutqin's standardized workflow.

decision.title: Regulator reviews
decision.description: Regulator reviews the submission in one queue, makes a decision based on regulations, and provides clear feedback if changes are needed.

publish.title: Activity published
publish.description: Once approved, the activity is published and becomes visible to HCPs who can browse, view details, and register for the event.

attendance.title: Event runs
attendance.description: During the event, digital attendance is captured, compliance records are maintained, and all data is submitted in real-time through Mutqin.

credits.title: Hours confirmed
credits.description: Accredited hours are confirmed and automatically appear in the HCP's record, with certificates available for download.

whoIsBehind.title: Who is behind Mutqin?
whoIsBehind.body: Mutqin is built by a Saudi team working at the intersection of healthcare education, compliance, and software. We focus on creating infrastructure that connects existing systems and workflows rather than replacing them.

items.question: Is Mutqin a CPD provider or an infrastructure layer?
items.answer: Mutqin is an infrastructure layer. We do not provide CME/CPD content or act as a CPD provider. Instead, we provide the digital platform that connects CPD providers, accrediting bodies, execution vendors, sponsors, and practitioners in one organized workflow.

items.question: Does Mutqin replace existing accreditation portals?
items.answer: No. Mutqin does not replace official accreditation portals or change existing regulations. It connects to existing workflows and systems, providing a unified interface that follows the same requirements defined by accrediting bodies.

items.question: How does Mutqin integrate with current systems?
items.answer: Mutqin is designed to integrate with existing systems through APIs and data exports. Integration approaches are configured with each organization according to its technical infrastructure and regulatory requirements.

items.question: Is Mutqin already live or in pilot?
items.answer: Mutqin is currently in a pilot phase with a select group of founding partners. We are working together to refine the platform based on real CME/CPD activities before broader deployment.
